lines.text: Previously. A Hydra in the lake at Marrowmere. Every head I cut grew back.
Rin tied all seven heads into one knot, and tied herself to it. I broke the heart.
Someone had burned the seal from inside. And there were feathers on the shore.
Then a hawk came. Fort Cinder needed every Hunter it could get.
Quiet night on the plain.
Too hot to be quiet.
Lights. On the plain. Red ones.
Those are eyes. Hundreds of them.
Listen. They are marching in step.
Ring the bell! RING THE BELL!
I love this place. Finally, somewhere warmer than my head.
I hate this place. My tail is sweating. I didn't know tails could sweat.
Sieg. Tell us about Red Giants. Properly. Not the way the Guild posters do.
lines.tts: Seeg. Tell us about Red Giants. Properly. Not the way the Guild posters do.

lines.text: You know the Iron Giants of the north mountains? Slow, huge, mostly harmless. They sleep for years.
Sometimes one wanders into a Rift and comes back out. Red. Hot inside. And angry at everything that moves.
How many at the fort?
The hawk said forty.
Forty?! Forty giants?!
Red Giants never travel together. One, sometimes two. Forty is not a raid. Forty is an army.
Armies need generals.
Yes. They do.
Takuto. Your axe is glowing.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Your axe is glowing.

lines.text: It's the heat.
It isn't the heat. Can you smell it, boy? Iron and fire. A battlefield. I haven't smelled one in three hundred years.
Calm down.
I'm perfectly calm. I'm just... looking forward to it.
Water to the east wall!
More arrows! Anybody, more arrows!
Valen. Thank the gods. Commander Hale. You brought Hunters.
Rank C and up to the north wall. Everyone else, supply and the infirmary.
I'm going to the wall.
You're rank F.
I killed a Behemoth. And a Hydra.
With help. On the wall there is no help. There is only the person next to you, and the drop.
Stay in the yard, Takuto. Carry water. Nobody ever died carrying water.
lines.tts: Stay in the yard, Tah-koo-toh. Carry water. Nobody ever died carrying water.

lines.text: I did almost die carrying water once.
Nobody normal.
The Laughing Blade. And his students. How sweet.
Vesper.
Who is she?
The Guild sends her when a Branded loses control. She is the one who stops them.
Stops them how?
Permanently.
Relax. I'm here for the giants. Forty Red Giants is a lot of loose Brands waiting to happen.
You must be the error. White hair. Red jacket. An axe with a reputation.
What reputation?
The last man who carried it destroyed three cities. Did nobody tell you?
Carry water, error. If I see that axe glow red on my battlefield, I'll take it from you. And your hands with it.
I don't like her.
I do. She smells like a storm. Like the last one who tried.
Six years, Sieg. You still laugh at everything?
lines.tts: Six years, Seeg. You still laugh at everything?

lines.text: Only at things that deserve it. You still visit old friends with a knife?
I visited you once. At Grey Hollow. You were the only one left standing, and the Guild wanted to know why.
And you decided I was still me.
You were sitting in the mud, counting the dead out loud. Over and over. A monster does not count.
...I never thanked you for that.
Don't. I would have done it if I had to. That's the job.
The boy is not a monster, Vesper.
Nobody is, until the day they are. You know what is inside that axe. You've read the old records, same as me.
Akuro. The Crimson Calamity.
lines.tts: Ah-koo-roh. The Crimson Calamity.

lines.text: Three cities. Sealed in a headsman's axe in a graveyard nobody visits. And now a Skyfallen boy carries it around like a lunchbox.
He carries it like someone who has nothing else.
...Then let us hope that is enough.
Forty giants. You know what forty giants is? That is a whole baseball team. Four baseball teams.
I don't know what baseball is.
It's a game where you hit a ball with a stick and then run away.
That's what we're doing tomorrow.
...Yeah. Yeah, it kind of is.
Rin. You haven't said anything all night.
I've never been on a wall before. A real siege. With a commander and bells and a line.
You'll be fine. You're rank C.
My brother was rank B.
...I'll be in the yard. If anything comes over the wall, it comes through me.
Through you. With an axe that can't block, and one harness block a day.
Then it'll only come through me once.
...That's not funny.
You smiled.
I did not.
She did.
She definitely did.
Go to sleep! All of you!
Forty giants, boy. Let me out a little tomorrow. Just a little.
No.
Here they come! Archers, draw!
They're walking in lines. Like soldiers.
Like someone taught them.
First one at the wall! Rin, its knees!
Red Thread! Its knee to the rock!
Afterimage!
BOULDER! Down, down!
Clumsy.
White Gale.
Down you go.
That's one. There are thirty-nine more.
Then we'd better not stop at one.
Second one on the ladder!
Rin, the hand on the battlement! Tie it!
Tied to the wall! Pull and you fall!
Not bad, little thread. Your brother taught you that?
You knew my brother?
Everyone on the frontier knew Kaito Ashveil. He was the only B-rank who ever made me laugh.
lines.tts: Everyone on the frontier knew Kaito Ash-vale. He was the only B-rank who ever made me laugh.

lines.text: ...He laughed at everything. It drove me crazy.
Then fight like he would. Laughing. Behind you!
I see it!
Twice! Always twice!
They broke the east gate!
Medic! I need a medic!
Water! Water to the north wall! Move!
Nemu! Two buckets! You only have one bucket!
lines.tts: Neh-moo! Two buckets! You only have one bucket!

lines.text: I have one bucket and one tail. The tail is helping.
The tail is not helping! The tail is dipping in the water!
It is cooling the water.
That is not how cooling works!
Wick. Is your head getting brighter? You said that happens when you are scared.
I said that happens when I am CALM. And in CONTROL.
...You are very calm right now.
I am TERRIFIED, Nemu.
lines.tts: I am TERRIFIED, Neh-moo.

lines.text: I carried forty buckets. FORTY. One for every giant.
The east gate.
Takuto. Sieg said the yard.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Seeg said the yard.

lines.text: Sieg said nothing comes over the wall. Something is coming through the gate.
lines.tts: Seeg said nothing comes over the wall. Something is coming through the gate.

lines.text: Then I come with you.
Stay with Wick. Keep the water coming. The wall needs it.
...You're going to do something stupid.
I'm going to do something useful.
In my experience those are the same thing!
You. Big one. Over here.
Break!
Its shell broke. Now its bones.
It's hot inside. Like hitting a furnace.
Again!
Three more.
Four. Five. Oh, boy. Look at them all.
Takuto! You idiot! I saw you from the wall!
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh! You idiot! I saw you from the wall!

lines.text: Go back up!
You're surrounded! Red Thread!
Hold still, you overgrown oven!
It snapped the threads! Let go of me!
RIN!
You can't reach her, boy. Not like this. Not with only your hands.
Open the door. Just a crack. Let me see.
...Just a crack.
Ahh. There you are.
Break! Break! BREAK!
Ha ha ha ha!
Takuto, stop! Takuto!
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh, stop! Tah-koo-toh!

lines.text: White Gale. Bind.
One more step, error, and the ribbons go through you instead of around you.
TAKUTO!
...Nemu?
lines.tts: ...Neh-moo?

lines.text: He's back. Vesper, look at him. Look at his eyes. He's back.
...This time.
Where is Rin?
Takuto. Look behind you.
lines.tts: Tah-koo-toh. Look behind you.

lines.text: Rin...
Did I... did I do that?
The medic says three ribs. And her arm. And she hit her head on the rocks.
She'll wake up. She's too angry not to.
Where's Takuto?
lines.tts: Where's Tah-koo-toh?

lines.text: Outside the door. He's been outside the door for four hours.
He won't come in?
He thinks if he comes in, he'll break something else.
The giants ran. Did you know that? After he... after the red. The rest of them turned around and walked away. In step.
Like someone called them home.
Thirty-one dead giants. The commander wants to give him a medal.
Don't tell him that. Not tonight.
Can I sit?
It's your fort.
It's Commander Hale's fort. He's very proud of it. He keeps calling the walls she.
What did it feel like?
Like being on fire and not caring. Like everything in front of me was made of glass.
And I liked it. Sieg, I liked it. That's the worst part.
lines.tts: And I liked it. Seeg, I liked it. That's the worst part.

lines.text: Of course you liked it. It's the strongest you've ever been. That is how it gets you.
Is there a way to stop it?
There is one way that always works. Vesper would be happy to show you.
And the other way?
Have people worth coming back for. Shout their names. Hear them shout yours.
Nemu brought you back today. Not Vesper. Not me. One little girl who sleeps all day screamed your name, and you came back.
lines.tts: Neh-moo brought you back today. Not Vesper. Not me. One little girl who sleeps all day screamed your name, and you came back.

lines.text: Rin shouted too. I didn't hear her.
...Then next time, listen harder.
Couldn't sleep, error?
You stopped me today.
I bound you. Your little cat girl stopped you. I want to be very clear about that.
I have stopped eleven Hunters who lost control. Every single one of them told me it would never happen again.
Then I won't say it.
...Good. That's the first honest thing a Branded has said to me in years.
The Guild will hear about today. They'll send me a letter. The letter will have your name in it.
And you'll come.
I always come. Make sure that when I do, I find a Hunter. Not the thing in your axe.
She means me. I am flattered. Truly.
And error. The giants were marching in step. Someone was walking them. You felt it too.
Static.
...So you have met him.
Haruki used to say I only had two settings. Asleep, and in a fight.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee used to say I only had two settings. Asleep, and in a fight.

lines.text: He was the one who stopped me. Every time. He would just put a hand on my shoulder, and the fight would go out of me.
Then he was gone. And I had nobody to stop me.
Today Nemu did it. I need to be the one who does it, next time.
lines.tts: Today Neh-moo did it. I need to be the one who does it, next time.

lines.text: You came in.
Nemu pushed me.
lines.tts: Neh-moo pushed me.

lines.text: ...Good for Nemu.
lines.tts: ...Good for Neh-moo.

lines.text: Rin. I'm sorry.
You looked like someone else. Your eyes. Your voice. You were laughing, Takuto.
lines.tts: You looked like someone else. Your eyes. Your voice. You were laughing, Tah-koo-toh.

lines.text: It wasn't me laughing.
I know. That's what scared me.
Don't be sorry. Be useful. That's what I said in the Wastes, isn't it?
You remember.
I remember everything I say. It's one of my best qualities.
Promise me something. When the axe talks to you, tell me. Every time. I don't care if it sounds crazy.
Every time?
Every time. If I know, I can tie you down before you go.
...It says you're loud.
It does not.
I did, actually.
It did, actually.
...Tell it I said thank you. For leaving.
Kirishima. Thirty-one Red Giants. The fort owes you its walls.
lines.tts: Kee-ree-shee-mah. Thirty-one Red Giants. The fort owes you its walls.

lines.text: The Order of the Ember. Take it, son. You earned it.
I don't want it.
Nobody refuses the Ember.
Did he just refuse the Ember?
Give it to the people who stayed on the wall. They did what they were told. I did not.
Commander. He means it. Put his name on the list of the dead giants instead. He will like that better.
I would have taken the medal.
You carried water.
Forty buckets!
Pack up. A letter came from the Guild with the dawn hawk. We go west, through the forest villages, toward the capital.
The capital. Saint Lumen?
The Gilded Order wants to look at you. After yesterday, everybody wants to look at you.
Haruki is in Saint Lumen. Wick heard about him. A Skyfallen who stops things.
lines.tts: Hah-roo-kee is in Saint Lumen. Wick heard about him. A Skyfallen who stops things.

lines.text: ...I know. Valentine told me. That is why I said yes.
And Rin?
Rin rides in the cart, with a blanket and a very bad temper. The medic says ten days.
She'll walk in three.
She'll walk in two, just to prove the medic wrong.
Six seconds, boy. You let me out for six seconds. Do you know how long three hundred years is, compared to six seconds?
You hurt her.
You hurt her. My hands were your hands. You were very proud of them, too.
It won't happen again.
Ha. Vesper's favourite sentence. Say it to her and see what happens.
...Then I won't say it. I'll just do it.
We will see, boy. Next time, ten seconds.
The Calamity woke.
For six seconds. Thirty-one of my giants. I was quite fond of them.
Then bring him to me. Before six seconds becomes sixty.
Bring him? Oh, Lucien. He'll walk to you himself. You have his friend.
Next time: a farming village on the edge of the great forest.
Plume Ogres attack. But they are not hunting. They are running.
Some Fiends can be talked to. And some of them are being herded.
Episode seven. Feathers and Ash.
